subject: Private Deployment: technical feasibility, staffing, and product gating
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@greenbank.com>
Cc: procurement@greenbank.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment request — feasibility check and asks

Team / Alex,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. Greenbank has asked us to scope a private VPC/on-prem deployment option for an initial pilot (payment flows + customer metadata). Before we engage procurement, I need a concise feasibility and resourcing read from infra/security/ops so I can summarize to sales. Can you review the attached matrix and respond with the following by Tue EOD (Oct 20):

- Feasibility: major blockers (network, packaging, compliance)
- Minimal pilot configuration (HW, network peering, isolation boundary)
- Staffing estimate to support pilot (oncall, SRE, infra eng) + rough cost drivers
- Gating criteria for product to be allowed to go live (security signoffs, metrics, runbook)

Attachment: VPC-readiness-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If anything needs clarification from Greenbank, loop Alex.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Oct 18, 2026 at 09:03 AM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@greenbank.com>
Cc: procurement@greenbank.com
Date: 2026-10-18 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment request — feasibility check and asks

Thanks Marissa. Initial thoughts from an infra lens:

1) Packaging and runtime: we need a deployable appliance (container + operator) that ships our runtime, model artifacts (quantized), and the control-plane agent. Building an on-prem installer + operator will take ~4–6 weeks of dev effort to be minimally viable.

2) Networking: Greenbank requires isolated peering. We'll need IPSEC or cloud VPN plus strict ACLs. Peering ops are usually 2–3 days of coordination but need network diagrams and contact points from Greenbank.

3) Ops & oncall: pilot needs runbook + an SRE oncall rotation (0.5 FTE dedicated for first 3 months). Without that we cannot guarantee the SLAs.

4) Data handling: disk encryption + validated KMS integration (customer-managed key preferred). Also need clarity on logs/metrics retention — Greenbank asked for audit log retention length.

5) Model performance: quantization tradeoffs will change latency/cost characteristics; we should baseline with a 2-node GPU pilot.

I'm attaching the security questionnaire Greenbank sent — this will drive the compliance gating.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep-dive on Mon Oct 19 10:00–11:00 PT to walk the matrix and identify absolute blockers. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: greenbank-security-questionnaire-v2.pdf

—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment request — feasibility check and asks

Agree with Diego's outline. A couple of practical constraints to call out from resourcing:

- Team bandwidth: we have two pilots overlapping in Oct–Nov; realistically we can assign 1.0 FTE infra eng + 0.5 FTE SRE for Greenbank pilot for the first 8 weeks.
- Minimal viable pilot: 2x A10G-like GPUs (or equivalent), a small control-plane VM, and an NFS-backed object store for model artifacts.
- Support model: remote ops (screen-sharing debug) + oncall for incidents; we cannot do daily on-prem visits.

If Greenbank requires more than 2x GPUs or on-site presence, staffing jumps significantly.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Engineering Manager, Platform

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment request — feasibility check and asks

Adding architecture details that affect feasibility/timeline:

- KV cache persistence: if Greenbank wants warm restarts we need a plan for snapshotting KV cache or accepting cold starts. Implementing cache snapshot/restore across nodes is nontrivial — estimate 3 weeks of eng work.
- Model artifact pipeline: we need a secure artifact sync mechanism (S3-compatible push or rsync-over-VPN). We'll support S3-compatible with presigned URLs to keep things simple.
- Throughput expectation: their RPS estimate (shared in the matrix) implies a 300k token/hour sustained workload at peak. For that, a 2-GPU pilot needs aggressive batching and possible quantization to INT8; we should budget for an extra perf sprint.

Estimated pilot timeline (staffed as above): 8 weeks to pilot readiness (including security questionnaire responses, runbook, and perf baseline).

—Karthik
Principal Architect

Thanks everyone — this is helpful. From product perspective the gating criteria we need before we present to execs: 

1) Security questionnaire fully answered and evidence attached.
2) Ops runbook + incident rollback tested in a staging environment.
3) Performance baseline that meets target p95 latency < 120ms for the critical path (payment flow).
4) Cost estimate for pilot and recurring monthly run costs.

Marissa: procurement will ask for a summary we can give Greenbank to show we have a low-risk operational model. Diego — can you produce a 1-page summary of the blockers, staffing, and timeline by Tue 10/20 noon so I can review before next Greenbank sync?

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Group Product Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Private deployment request — technical feasibility, staffing, and gating (summary & next steps)

Folks — consolidated summary and action items below (for Marissa/Hannah to use in external comms).

Short summary (one-liner): A constrained on-prem/VPC pilot for Greenbank is feasible but requires an oncall commitment, a small engineering sprint for packaging and cache snapshotting, and a security evidence package to clear gating.

Blockers & risks:
- Security evidence: the questionnaire has 12 high-priority asks (KMS, audit retention, pen-test scope). We must provide evidence for KMS integration and encryption-in-transit at a minimum.
- Packaging: needs 4–6 weeks of work for a deployable operator and installer.
- Cache persistence: optional for initial pilot; if required, add ~3 weeks.
- Ops staffing: recommend 0.5 FTE SRE + 1.0 FTE infra eng dedicated for first 8 weeks; additional oncall rotation as pilot scales.

Estimated timeline: 8 weeks to pilot readiness (depends on Greenbank responsiveness to questionnaire).

Pilot baseline config (minimal):
- 2x A10G-class GPUs (or equivalent)
- control-plane VM + NFS/object store for artifacts
- VPN/IPSEC peering with strict ACLs

Cost drivers:
- Dedicated GPU hours (primary)
- Engineering packaging & perf work (one-time)
- Oncall SRE staffing (recurring)

Gating criteria (to go live beyond pilot): security evidence accepted, runbook and rollback tested in staging, p95 latency < 120ms, agreed SLA and cost terms.

Action items:
- Diego: produce one-page exec summary + attachments (due Tue 10/20 12:00 PT) [IN PROGRESS]
- Soojin: confirm staffing allocation with people ops (due Wed 10/21)
- Karthik: draft cache snapshot plan and perf sprint scope (due Wed 10/21)
- Marissa/Hannah: coordinate procurement message and next external sync (Marissa to own)

Proposed next steps: 60-minute technical working session (invite sent) and then a security evidence packet handoff to Greenbank.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=greenbank-private-deploy-dive
Attachments: VPC-readiness-matrix.xlsx, greenbank-security-questionnaire-v2.pdf

Thanks — I'll convert this into the 1-page and upload to the Confluence link.
—Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
